issues.description: API endpoint hardcoded without environment variable configuration

issues.description: No error handling for network failures or timeout scenarios
issues.suggestion: Add try-catch blocks and implement retry logic with exponential backoff for failed requests

issues.description: Magic number 5000 for timeout is undocumented

codeQuality.summary: Service layer has critical security issues and poor error handling. Hardcoded endpoints and lack of retry logic pose significant risks to application reliability.

untestedPaths.reasoning: Core data fetching function used by entire application
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Mock fetch and test success response, error response, timeout, and network failure scenarios

untestedPaths.reasoning: Destructive operation that cannot be undone
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test deletion of non-existent IDs, concurrent deletion attempts, and rollback scenarios

untestedPaths.reasoning: Error scenarios are not properly tested and could cause silent failures
untestedPaths.suggestedTest: Test all error paths including 4xx, 5xx responses, network errors, and timeout cases

testCoverage.summary: Service layer test coverage is inadequate. Critical API functions and error paths are not properly tested, leaving production vulnerabilities undetected.

suggestions.description: Implement Repository pattern to separate API concerns from business logic
suggestions.benefits: Improves testability through dependency injection, enables easy API client swapping, provides clear interface contracts

suggestions.description: Create ApiClient wrapper to handle common concerns like timeout, logging, error handling
suggestions.before:
const response = await fetch(url, { timeout: 5000 });
if (!response.ok) throw new Error('API Error');
suggestions.after: const response = await apiClient.request('GET', url, { timeout: 5000 });
suggestions.benefits: Centralizes HTTP concerns, reduces code duplication, improves consistency across service layer

refactorings.summary: Service layer needs architectural improvements including API client abstraction and Repository pattern implementation for better maintainability and testability.

testCoverage.summary: Good baseline test coverage but missing integration tests for critical user flows like adding and loading todos. Consider adding E2E tests.

suggestions.description: Extract todo list filtering and sorting logic into custom hook useTodoFiltering
suggestions.benefits: Improves readability, enables memoization for performance, makes filtering logic testable in isolation

refactorings.summary: App component can be simplified by extracting filtering logic and organizing state management more clearly.

recommendations.description: Remove hardcoded API endpoint from todoService.ts and implement environment variable configuration. This is a security risk that could expose internal API endpoints.
Implement comprehensive error handling in service layer. Currently no retry logic or proper error propagation exists for network failures, which will cause silent application failures in production.
Increase test coverage for critical paths. Focus on API service layer testing (currently 55%) and TodoItem delete functionality. Use mocking libraries to isolate units properly.
Implement Repository pattern for API service layer to separate concerns and improve testability. Create ApiClient abstraction to handle common HTTP concerns like timeout and logging.
Add null safety checks throughout components. TodoItem component lacks defensive programming for null/undefined props which could cause runtime crashes.
